provenance.method: Loaded and answered Image to 3d at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Image to 3d requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Image to 3d requests on a 1024×1280 photo.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Image to 3d requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Image to 3d request on a 1024×1280 photo.

provenance.method: Wall time of the timed (second) Image to 3d request, one sample, after one ordinary Load, then two Image to 3d requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; includes the API round trip. test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.
